remediationsApplied.issue: Authorization header vs cookie precedence collision across concurrent clients
remediationsApplied.remediation: Updated JwtAuthGuard to check Bearer token header before falling back to cookies.

remediationsApplied.issue: Algorithm confusion / alg:none token acceptance in TokenService verification
remediationsApplied.remediation: Explicitly restricted algorithms to ['HS256'] in TokenService.verifyAccessToken.

remediationsApplied.issue: Prisma P2023 malformed UUID query throwing unhandled 500 error
remediationsApplied.remediation: Mapped Prisma P2023 to 400 Bad Request and P2025 to 404 Not Found in GlobalExceptionFilter.

remediationsApplied.issue: Nginx container internal health check routed through WAF triggering false-positive scanner alert
remediationsApplied.remediation: Configured dedicated internal location = /nginx-health bypass in Nginx docker config.

remediationsApplied.issue: DNS getaddrinfo blocking latency on ml-service container restart in MLClient
remediationsApplied.remediation: Added IP caching and resilient reconnect loop in MLClient.
